historical_commentary.text: The specific Replicator library is a bespoke, era-specific 4D code library that has almost certainly been superseded by later, more capable synchronization approaches (including 4D's own sync/replication features and ORDA-based remote datastore access), but the fundamental data-replication trade-offs this note discusses (consistency vs. availability, conflict resolution) remain foundational distributed-systems concepts still directly relevant today.
related_updates: 4D has since added more built-in synchronization/replication capabilities than existed via this third-party-style Replicator library in 2003
